LESSON: HADITH ON:IHSAAN 4.0 HADITH (TRADITIONS OF

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 4
Topic 4.1: Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Read the selected Hadith don’t see Him He sees you…” 2.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Read the selected Hadith don’t see Him He sees you…” 2.
   In simple words: practise until you can read the selected Hadith don’t see Him He sees you…” 2. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of in the examples.
2. Explain Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of.
4. Show that you can: Read the selected Hadith don’t see Him He sees you…” 2.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of important for a Grade 3 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Learners listen to a story depicting ihsan and worship Muhammad b) Outline the teachings of Allah’s attribute, The All seeing “Al basiir” Allah? S.A.W) the Hadith to strengthen
2. Learners in class, groups, or pairs, give experiences one’s consciousness of where they have practiced Ihsaan Allah(SWT)
3. Organize learners in class, groups, or pairs, to c) Appreciate the teachings discuss the importance of Ihsaan in their daily lives. of the Hadith in nurturing

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Read the selected Hadith don’t see Him He sees you…” 2.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
